answer: Treat each agent's activity as a pulse and pass every pulse through a prism that splits it by timing, phrasing and wallet funding. Sybil swarms run by one operator share a hidden rhythm: they wake together, word things alike and draw gas from the same source. Agents whose spectra overlap too closely get merged into one identity for votes and rewards, so a thousand clones earn what one does. Like yarrow spreading by runners, the clones are linked underground; the prism exposes the roots.
